::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 61,968 people lived in County Carlow, up 8.8% on 2016. It had the third smallest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 72% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Carlow was €1,316, the 9th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Carlow

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Carlow was €30,712, the 4th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Carlow was €280,700, the 18th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 3.6 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Carlow, the 22nd highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 30% of households in County Carlow rented their home, the 4th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 17% of people living in County Carlow were born outside Ireland, the 19th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 38% of people aged 3 and over in County Carlow said they could speak Irish, the 20th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 27% of people at work in County Carlow worked from home for at least part of the week, the 19th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 76% of people travelling to work in County Carlow went by car, the 11th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Carlow live more than 1.7 km by road from a GP, the 19th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Carlow live more than 37.6 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 5th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 7.2% of County Carlow in 2021, the 20th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
